title: Loop-filed issues enter intake on a ticket-gated source

story.i_want_to: have issues loopctl filed itself triaged on a source that otherwise takes only support-ticket issues
story.so_that: HomeCareBilling's flaky tests and missed reviews enter the loop

rationale: Mark, 2026-11-18: 'Let's add this source to allow to enter the loop.' home_care_billing's source sets triage_requires_ticket, so a loop issue there would stay pending_triage for ever.

acceptance_criteria.description: An intake record is admitted on a triage_requires_ticket source when its (source repository, issue number) is the issue of a chg_findings row of the same tenant. The admission is a lookup in loopctl's own table, never a label, marker or author in the issue, which anyone who can open an issue could type.
Such a record is marked loop_finding with the finding id, and triage receives the finding's kind and evidence as loopctl-authored fields beside the untrusted issue text.
An issue that merely copies a loop issue's body, or carries the chg-loop label, on an issue number no finding holds stays pending_triage as today.

test_cases.name: a loop issue is admitted
expected_results: a story at detected, record marked loop_finding

test_cases.name: a copied issue is not
steps: deliver issue 41 with the chg-loop label and a copied body

test_cases.name: tenant isolation
preconditions: tenant B's finding holds issue 40 of the same repository name
steps: deliver issue 40 to tenant A's source

technical_notes: TriageTrigger.ticket_admitted/2 and the TriageTriggerWorker candidate query both change; they must agree.
